ducted_fan.notes: Ports on the top face (y = 8) at the +z edge (z = 47): rotation x = 24, power x = 25, speed x = 26. Mount strip (JointsArea) is the +z face for x 16-31. IRREGULAR: the duct is round (6 m across). All 6 corpus instances have frames and cables in the empty corners of the 48x8x48 bounding box (z 44-47, x 0-12 and 35-47), hence the overlaps and the 36 cable "misses". Treat the bounding box as occupied (safe over-approximation). The fan tilts with the rotation input, so its swept volume can leave the box. Blows along -y at rotation 0.

SC_GimbalThruster.name: RCS Thruster

_channel.meaning: RCS Thruster mode knob (float 0..1, 6 steps). Saved values are (2k+1)/12, i.e. the centres of 6 equal bins: mode k = floor(value*6). Corpus torque analysis (the thruster force about the ship centroid, in the pilot seat frame; ~89% consistent): modes 0/1 = yaw (torque -y/+y), 2/3 = pitch (+x/-x), 4/5 = roll (+z/-z), matching the controller inputs yaw/pitch/roll. Signs are tentative.

_col.meaning: paint colour index (cosmetic; 0xc8/0xc9 are the unpainted factory finishes)
